rule.title: Mandatory Tenant and User Scoping on Database Queries
rule.statement: Every database query retrieving or mutating user-owned resources must include an explicit WHERE userId = :currentUserId or orgId filter.
rule.rationale: Failing to scope queries to the authenticated user leads directly to Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA), allowing unauthorized cross-user data access.
rule.implementation_guidance: Always inject req.user.id into Service methods and enforce it in Prisma find, update, and vector cosine queries.

forbidden.example: await prisma.knowledgeBase.findUnique({ where: { id } }); // Missing user ownership verification

preferred.example: await prisma.knowledgeBase.findFirst({ where: { id, userId: currentUser.id } });

source.chapter: Chapter 4: Input Validation and Output Sanitization
source.evidence_quote: Access control checks must ensure that the user requesting the resource has legitimate ownership. Scoping queries by user ID prevents unauthorized object access.
